lane_visibility.note: the lane's receipt lists /home /tmp /var/tmp /run/user as hidden, but a list is not a measurement, so each root is asked directly: a fresh directory is made under it and the lane is asked whether it exists. This is how the lane's own defect was found — /tmp is mounted tmpfs by the host here, and the lane used to treat an existing tmpfs mount as already hidden and skip the mount, so the lane's /tmp was the host's /tmp and this canary read VISIBLE. `_hide` now replaces every root with a verified tmpfs of the lane's own, and /tmp measures hidden. The before side's reproduction is placed under the first root this measurement finds hidden; the probe refuses to run when there is none.
